title: Choi-Yong

symbol.name: Choi-Yong
symbol.meaning: General Choe Yeong · ITF pattern 18 of 24

note.p: Choi-Yong is named after General Choe Yeong, premier and commander-in-chief of the armed forces of Goryeo in the 14th century, greatly respected for his loyalty, patriotism and humility. He was executed by his subordinate commanders, led by General Yi Seong-gye, who later became the first king of the Joseon (Yi) dynasty. You start in close ready stance C at the centre facing D: guarding blocks and middle-knuckle punches in rear foot stance; knife-hand rising blocks, circular blocks and punches along the C–D line; low guarding blocks with a turning kick, reverse hooking kick, side kick and elbow strike to each end; palm pressing blocks; knife-hand W-shape blocks with front kicks; fingertip thrusts; then to B and A, palm hooking blocks and punches in parallel stance, side kicks from bending ready stance, jumps into X-stance with back fist strikes, reverse hooking kicks and knife-hand strikes, and a sliding side punch to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (46 movements, one technique each). The moves go back and forth through the centre of the + diagram, so the board shows them in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AD, AC and BD are diagonals. Finish by bringing the right foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the C–D line facing D in close ready stance C.
Move the left foot to D into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
In the same stance, left middle knuckle fist high punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a left rear foot stance facing C (right foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
In the same stance, right middle knuckle fist high punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a left walking stance facing D. Left knife-hand rising block.
In the same stance, right inner forearm circular block toward AD.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Move the left foot along the C–D line into a right walking stance facing C. Right knife-hand rising block.
In the same stance, left inner forearm circular block toward AC.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Right middle turning kick toward AD, then lower the right foot to the side front of the left foot.
Left high reverse hooking kick toward D.
Without setting the foot down, left middle side piercing kick toward D, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the left foot toward D into a left walking stance. Right front elbow strike into the left palm.
Move the left foot along the C–D line into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Left middle turning kick toward AC, then lower the left foot to the side front of the right foot.
Right high reverse hooking kick toward C.
Without setting the foot down, right middle side piercing kick toward C, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right walking stance. Left front elbow strike into the right palm.
Move the left foot to C into a left walking stance. Right palm pressing block.
Move the right foot to C into a right walking stance. Left palm pressing block, fast after 21.
Move the right foot toward D, then the left foot toward D, turning counter-clockwise into a left walking stance facing D. Knife-hand W-shape block.
Right middle front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot back toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to D into a right walking stance. Knife-hand W-shape block.
Left middle front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.

Move the left foot toward C and the right foot toward C, then slide toward C turning clockwise into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance. Left flat fingertip high thrust.
Move the left foot along the C–D line into a right walking stance facing C. Right flat fingertip high thrust.
Move the right foot toward D, turning clockwise into a parallel stance facing B. Right palm middle hooking block toward B.
In the same stance, left middle punch toward B.
Turn the face toward A, drawing the right foot up into a left bending ready stance A, side-on to A.
Right middle side piercing kick toward A, forming a forearm guarding block.
Land the right foot toward A with a jump, into a right X-stance facing AD. Right back fist high side strike toward A, the left fingertips on the right side fist.
Right high reverse hooking kick toward B.
Stamp the right foot down toward B into a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand middle outward strike.
Move the left foot toward D, turning counter-clockwise into a parallel stance facing A. Left palm middle hooking block toward A.
In the same stance, right middle punch toward A.
Turn the face toward B, drawing the left foot up into a right bending ready stance A, side-on to B.
Left middle side piercing kick toward B, forming a forearm guarding block.
Land the left foot toward B with a jump, into a left X-stance facing BD. Left back fist high side strike toward B, the right fingertips on the left side fist.
Left high reverse hooking kick toward A.
Stamp the left foot down toward A into a right L-stance facing A (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left knife-hand middle outward strike.
Slide toward A, keeping the left foot forward, into a fixed stance facing A (the texts call it a right fixed stance). Right middle side punch toward A.
